description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesContextMenu' which renders a context menu for notes in a web application. It integrates multiple controllers and manages UI state such as menu visibility and click outside behavior.

methods.name: closeMenu
methods.description: A function to toggle the visibility of the context menu by updating the 'contextMenuOpen' state

methods.name: handleDisableClickOutsideRequest
methods.description: A callback to disable or enable clicking outside the popover, updating 'disableClickOutside' state
